title: Broken Chunky Font
author: afkaristudio
description:
Broken Chunky is a classy bold script font that combines expressive handwriting with a bold, stylish look. Its handwritten character adds personality to every design. Meanwhile, its chunky strokes create a strong and eye-catching appearance.
Designed for creatives who love distinctive typography, Broken Chunky brings a balance of elegance and casual charm. Its bold script style helps your text stand out while maintaining a natural, handwritten feel. As a result, it works beautifully for both modern and timeless design concepts.
With its chunky appearance and flowing script character, Broken Chunky gives your typography a memorable personality. Use it to create bold headlines, stylish wordmarks, or expressive lettering compositions. It is an excellent choice for designers seeking a classy script font with a strong visual presence.
Whether you are creating branding materials, social media graphics, or packaging designs, Broken Chunky adds a distinctive handwritten touch to your work.
Features;
– Broken Chunky (OTF/TTF/WOFF2)
– Classy Bold Script Font
– Natural and expressive typography
– Uppercase & lowercase characters
– Numbers & punctuation
– Smooth script connections
– Ideal for branding & signature logos
– Accessible in Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign, and even work on Microsoft Word
– PUA Encoded Characters – Fully accessible without additional design software.
